 Uber Q3 Earnings: Gross bookings, AV expansion, and margins in focus
 Nov 03, 2026, 9:26 AM ET Uber Technologies, Inc. (UBER) Stock By : Harsh Shukla , SA News Editor 
 Uber ( UBER ) is set to announce third-quarter earnings on Wednesday, and investors will watch for the ride-hailing platform’s gross bookings, or GBs, growth, autonomous investment plans, as well as margin growth.

 Can Uber sustain gross bookings growth amid regional headwinds? 
 Truist data indicates Q3 mobility bookings tracked expectations while delivery bookings outpaced consensus. Tougher U.S. mobility comparisons and competition in Brazil remain headwinds. 
 Can Uber's autonomous vehicle partnerships generate attractive returns? 
 Uber says it is on track to launch in 15 cities by year-end. Evercore says the company must keep vehicles busy, earn attractive returns, and remain a valuable source of riders for partners. 
 Can Uber's acquisitions strengthen its delivery and business offerings? 
 Truist views the Delivery Hero acquisition positively for expanding Uber's cross-platform strategy. The ezCater deal is intended to combine its catering expertise with Uber Eats' reach and Uber for Business relationships.
